scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Seven figures in patched ancient robes sit beside a rising stone path. A gray-bearded elder holds one hand to his chest and opens the other as a woman in an ochre hood touches a youth's shoulder. scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering gives a communal voice to Israel's remembrance of repeated affliction. The different ages evoke a people's history; the youth is not a named sufferer or proof of a particular incident. Worn garments and the constrained stone path suggest hardship indirectly. The rising path nods to the Song of Ascents heading. The verse does not specify these people, this setting or a particular attack.
